subject: [New] Migrate zmalloc.c unit tests to new test framework. (#493)
reason: The change is a pure test-infrastructure migration: it moves zmalloc's unit tests from the old SERVER_TEST in-binary framework (code compiled only under #ifdef SERVER_TEST, absent from production builds) into the new standalone unit test framework (new src/unit/test_zmalloc.c plus test_files.h registrations). No production code path, allocator behaviour, command, reply, replication or persistence logic changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario against a running server could exercise or compare.
